core_obligations: Base-change and shearing (proof lines 871-885): Omega_{G x_S G/G} = pr_0^* Omega (01V0, viewing the product over G via pr_1); the shearing map is a pr_1-automorphism, giving tau^* pr_0^* Omega = pr_0^* Omega, i.e. m^* Omega = pr_0^* Omega since pr_0 of the shearing is m.
Pullback to G (proof lines 887-893): pulling back along (e f, id_G) with m (e f, id) = id and pr_0 (e f, id) = e f yields Omega_{G/S} = f^* e^* Omega_{G/S}.
Conormal and freeness (proof lines 894-901): 0474 gives C_{S/G} = e^* Omega_{G/S}; over a field every O_S-module is free, so Omega_{G/S} is free.
proof_roadmap: Compute differentials of the product and transport them along the shearing automorphism (proof lines 871-885).
Pull back along the identity section to get the canonical isomorphism (proof lines 887-893).
Identify the conormal sheaf and deduce freeness over a field (proof lines 894-901).
